scripts.openapi:export: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --project apps/api --directory ../.. python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.test:integration: RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 MAIL__SUPPRESS_SEND=${MAIL__SUPPRESS_SEND:-1} uv run --project apps/api --directory ../.. pytest -m integration --cov=apps.api.src
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api --directory ../.. python -m tortoise -c apps.api.src.core.database.orm.TORTOISE_ORM makemigrations
scripts.jobs:worker: uv run --project apps/api --directory ../.. taskiq worker apps.api.src.infra.jobs.taskiq_app:broker apps.api.src.infra.jobs.tasks
scripts.jobs:scheduler: uv run --project apps/api --directory ../.. taskiq scheduler apps.api.src.infra.jobs.taskiq_app:scheduler apps.api.src.infra.jobs.tasks
